The '''Golden Globe Award for Best Screenplay – Motion Picture''' is a [[Golden Globe Awards|Golden Globe Award]] first given by the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association]], now awarded by [[Dick Clark Productions]] since 2023.

==Winners and nominees==

† marks the winner of the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay and Best Motion Picture Story

‡ marks the winner of the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay
